title: Alliance Nodduɗo Bonnugol
intro: Imagine wonde aɗa hoɗi e les njiimaandi gooto e wahyu, kono suɓaade nuunɗal ceertungal. Ndeeɗoo limoore wuuri ko no feewi e goonga e annabaagal, kono ina ruttoo e saliiɓe ɗum. Daartol maɓɓe ina darii e jeertinaango laaɓtungo wonde ɓadtaade peewal tan waawaa hisnude ruuhu janfotooɗo hoolaare.
clues: Mi hoɗii e galle annabi mbo Allah suɓii.
Miɗo anndi goonga mo gorko am waajotoo, kono mi goongɗinaani ɗum no feewi.
Mi janfii hoolaare makko e wondude e yimɓe makko jaɓooɓe e wallude ɓe e makko.
Mi siftinaama e bannge jom suudu annabi goɗɗo mo kadi janfi, ko yeru wonande keefeerɓe.
Daartol am ina winndaa e Suura At-Tahrim ngam jeertinande wonde banndiraagal e annabaaɓe rokkataa ndeenka.
Mi halkii e tooñooɓe nde Alla halki ɓesngu Luudu, accidi e heddiiɓe ɓee.

Werlo cukalel ngel nder maayo nder laynde ngam hisnugo ngel

Ardiima konu elefoŋaaji ngam finnude Kaaba
trial.answer: Janfi annabi e wallude keefeerɓe e makko

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Birniji leñol Luut ɗi njippinaa
Laana kaa mahaa ko e yamiroore Alla
Yiite ngee waɗi cooyngal wonande Ibraahiima
Ngaska rewre sukaaɓe ɗaaniiɓe

outcome.label: Keeɓal

Hisnaama e gooŋɗinɓe, naati Aljanna e jam
Wayliima wonti piilngal ngam wonde maande yontaaji garooji
Waɗii leydi e ngalu keewngu
Hokkaama ɓiɗɗo kaawis e nder mawngu mum
outcome.answer: Halkii e heeferɓe hay so dewgal e annabi

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
